--- stderr
Usage of push:
  -chunk-size string
    	upload blobs larger than this in chunks of this size, e.g. 64MiB (0: whole blobs, chunks only after the registry refuses one as too large) (default "0")
  -concurrency int
    	blobs transferred at once (0: 64)
  -piece-size string
    	split files larger than this into layers of this size (default "64MiB")
  -plain-http
    	talk to the registry over plain HTTP
